definition: Wispr Flow is a speech recognition and dictation software application developed by Wispr AI.
details: It converts spoken language into text across multiple platforms, including macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android. The software integrates with system-level input fields, allowing voice input in various applications.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. Here is the short version: Wispr Flow is a speech recognition and dictation software application developed by Wispr AI. The part that makes it sing: It converts spoken language into text across multiple platforms, including macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Wispr Flow — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
